summary: This plugin adds Chat and Work mode navigation to the DeepSeek Harness web UI and keeps non-project conversations organized in a managed Chat workspace for easier switching and context handling.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily a user-interface session navigation enhancement for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: it introduces Chat/Work mode navigation and manages a managed Chat workspace that appears in the sidebar. Evidence shows it registers mode segments, derives mode from where a conversation is stored, and keeps the Chat workspace group first via host/browser-side workspace ordering, rather than changing agent tooling or external integrations directly. Overall, its user-facing value is organizing conversational workflows and project/non-project context switching in the UI.
